name: C-Eval
intro: C-Eval 包含 13,948 道中文多项选择题，覆盖 52 个学科。每学科开发集的逐步解释先由 GPT-4 根据标准答案生成，再经人工修订；官方报告零样本仅答案、五样本仅答案和五样本思维链三种模式。论文时期测试标签私有，但官方仓库自 2025-07-27 起已公开完整测试集。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Tsinghua University, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technolo
build_method: 考试题解析与四选项/LaTeX规范化, 多轮人工验证, GPT-4生成开发集解释后人工修订
eval_feature: 零样本仅答案, 五样本仅答案, 五样本思维链, 正则选项抽取, 测试集公开版本边界
drawio_review_note: REDRAW. Reviewed against arXiv:2305.08322v3 §2-§3 and official repository commit cba65ae93bcf189149ced9f66ae0c958201faed9. The diagram restores the paper's GPT-4 step-by-step explanation generation followed by manual revision for five development exemplars per subject, and separates the three official reporting modes: zero-shot answer-only, five-shot answer-only, and five-shot CoT. It also marks the version boundary: test labels were private in the 2023 paper protocol, while the repository has published the complete test set since 2025-07-27.
build_method_en: Exam parsing and four-choice/LaTeX normalization, multi-round human validation, then GPT-4 dev explanations with manual revision
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot answer-only, five-shot answer-only, five-shot CoT, regex option extraction, and a public-test version boundary
intro_en: C-Eval contains 13,948 Chinese multiple-choice questions across 52 subjects. GPT-4 generates step-by-step explanations for each subject's development exemplars from the ground-truth answers, followed by manual revision. Official reporting separates zero-shot answer-only, five-shot answer-only, and five-shot CoT. Test labels were private in the paper, but the official repository has exposed the complete test set since 2025-07-27.
